reason: My architect already does the 3D models and renders and it's baked into their fee, so I'd be paying twice for something clients already get. On 7-20 homes a year, $1,500 each is real money off my margin.
objection: Is $1,500 a home worth it on our margins when my architect's renders already cover this and most of my clients come from referrals anyway?
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it sells or closes buyers faster on my spec homes, or a deal where I only pay when a client signs, priced well under $500 a home.
